goals: Verify that the NumericInput component correctly handles and applies various input properties and attributes with different input types
Verify that the NumericInput component disables inline styles on all rendered elements when the style property is set to false
activities: For each property configuration and mapped input value, render NumericInput with the specific property and value.
Retrieve the resulting property value from the rendered component.
Assert that the retrieved value matches the expected output.
Assert that the default attribute state in the component's outerHTML matches expectations based on the property name.
Render NumericInput with style set to false.
Traverse the rendered component's DOM tree and assert that no element has a 'style' attribute.
Render NumericInput with style set to false and mobile prop enabled.
Traverse the rendered component's DOM tree and assert that no element has a 'style' attribute.
